tasks.label: Ejecutar MetalGest
tasks.command: $out = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'MetalGest-build'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $out | Out-Null; & 'C:\jdk\bin\javac.exe' -encoding UTF-8 -d $out (Get-ChildItem 'src\main\java' -Recurse -Filter *.java | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName }); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & 'C:\jdk\bin\java.exe' -cp $out modulos.MetalGestApp
